scope: Scripted simulation replay; not hardware observation or physical accuracy
assumptions: CAD subset with imported reference-model articulation template. NOT photos-only reconstruction.
Eleven nominal structural components from supplied STEP; 259 other leaves omitted, including 11 empty leaves. Servos, fasteners, electronics and camera geometry are not represented.
All part placements and joint pivots at reference q=0 come from Pinned Menagerie SO101 f3b6013629c7b94f8ee93fd977b161fa8350f9bc. Original STEP placements are preserved in inventory.json.
Grouping is an explicit template proposal. CAD/source correspondence uses the earlier nominal local-frame comparison; there is no fitted scale or geometry deformation.
Root clearance +0.05 m is assumed. Hardware zeros/signs, gripper 0-100 conversion, mounting, mass distribution and servo dynamics remain unverified.
Masses are sourced full-link estimates including hardware whose visuals are omitted. Box collisions and uniform-box inertia remain approximations; generated dynamics may fail validation.
Joint sliders and FK comparison verify conversion consistency with the same template, not independent physical accuracy.
Guided grouping; review acknowledgements are engineering decisions, not physical measurement or accuracy certification.
Collision revision: per-link visual-mesh convex hull; fills concavities and does not model exact CAD surface contact.
Direct joint-connected body pairs explicitly excluded, including the fixed base/shoulder. Other self and ground contacts remain enabled.

Free-space motion validation scenario: root height 0.15 m, increased from assumed 0.05 m. Not measured mounting geometry. Original ideal half-limit sweep put gripper 0.01693 m below ground; this scenario adds 0.10 m clearance. Physical setup must use measured placement.
collision_policy: per-link convex hull of visual mesh; concavities filled
replay_timing: Approximate GIF timing (10 ms resolution), with reset on loop
